# R5.7 — Adopt a launched subject through the existing runtime

Implements `docs/tickets/176_R5.7__adopt.md` (seq 176 of 246). Requirement IDs stamped: **REQ-E-201, REQ-C-103** (primary; merged aliases REQ-E-001/101). Spec: `docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md` §2.1/AC-2-1; PADR-R5-1 (admitted GATE-G9).

**Deviation (conspicuous):** 1,124 changed source/test lines vs ≤750 contract flag — accepted as recorded Deviation per **Amended 2026-11-02 ruling** (commit `4517d185`; scoped split review verdict: atomic `adopt_subject` owner seam, no documented phase cut — precedent R5.6 AMEND).

## Summary

Lands `adopt_subject(binding, environment, ports)*` — the PADR-R5-1 A.2 embed arming/drive owner seam — as an **in-process** `EmbedService` method (`crates/hh-embed/src/adopt.rs`): no public RPC, no new event class, no second runtime (dossier non-admission ledger). A recipe launches through `lab.experiment.*`, then adopts the launched subject through the existing runtime: the durable `launch_bound` record is re-read (`ExperimentView::fold` — the same projection the R5.6 `launch_binding` reader runs, never caller-trusted), run/plan/attempt/config/environment/root/generation are validated against the durable prefix, the launch's own subject writer is proven live by `renew` (never a second writer), the environment is provisioned once through `provision_environment` (a matched durable env is reused, never re-minted), `lifecycle.session.attached{mode:"adopt", intent_ref, run_plan_id, attempt_no}` extends the existing class (dossier A.3), and the leaf arms via `arm_driver` or resumes via `arm_resume_driver` by the persisted `leaf.arm`+`leaf.checkpoint` pair.

Smallest supported composition (recorded in `runs/R5.7.md` + ADR-0386): `local_host` env, scripted `EmbedModel` lane, `hh/react-minimal` control + `static` compute, no sealed definition, no router/model_port lane, no supplies — absent capabilities stay typed refusals.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-embed/src/adopt.rs` (new): `AdoptBinding`/`AdoptPorts`/`AdoptOutcome` + `adopt_subject`; typed refusals `adopt_binding_not_bound`, `adopt_stale_binding`, `adopt_missing_writer`, `adopt_writer_run_mismatch`, `adopt_unknown_subject`, `adopt_run_finished`, `adopt_duplicate`, `adopt_manifest_mismatch:<member>`, `adopt_root_mismatch`, `adopt_environment_mismatch`, `adopt_writer_stale` — all before any subject-run mutation.
- `crates/hh-embed/src/open.rs`/`service.rs`/`lib.rs`: `environment_spec`, `arm_driver`, `arm_resume_driver` → `pub(crate)`; `HostCap` → `pub`; `pub mod adopt`.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_7.rs`: 4-test acceptance battery over a real `ExperimentEngine` launch + `EmbedService` on the same scratch store.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0386-*` (8 landing decisions) + regenerated ADR index / `REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md` / `BACKLOG.csv` sources home.
- `docs/build/runs/R5.7.md` run ledger; GATE-G8/G9 verbatim in the contract's Gate status.
